title: Floor Approximation Error Bound
statement: As $\delta$ tends to $0$ through nonnegative real values, $\sqrt{1/\lfloor 1/\delta\rfloor}-\sqrt{\delta}$ is $O(\delta^{3/2})$, where $\lfloor 1/\delta\rfloor$ is the greatest integer at most $1/\delta$.
